payload.body: Two things (vc decision 11). Tell me what ST0002 AC-02.1 still needs beyond this run: if it is a push of a candidate/** branch, that is hv's, and I'll put it to hv. Nothing from the People tree goes in. cc keeps the removals, the no-Python gate and the live parity; send each draft to me for review before it lands.
